name: Matthias Crane
silhouette: Precise, black coat, white stock, spectacles, bound statute book under the arm.
speech_rhythm: Complete sentences with citations. Deadpan. Humor entirely accidental.
public_motivation: Enforce the Compact to the letter.
private_motivation: Prove Aldmere could run the canal; a six-year report.
contradiction: The rule-bound official becomes the truth's best witness because he will not lie.
secret: Has been counting the water himself; his figures match Quenn's.
